verdict.rationale: Martin supports several recurring background jobs out of the box — daily/weekly email briefings, daily wake-up calls, ongoing email triage, and reminders — which cover the 'recurring jobs' part of the story. However, its 'shortcuts' feature (multi-step actions) is not documented as schedulable/recurring, so there's no evidence of general-purpose recurring workflow automation beyond the fixed set of built-in background tasks. Missing for 10: evidence that custom shortcuts/workflows can be scheduled on a recurring basis, and any user-defined interval/cron-like configuration beyond daily/weekly presets.
